evidence: Caes. BG 1.21: quālis esset nātūra montis et quālis in circuitū ascēnsus (Lewis & Short)
Lewis & Short: “a circuit, compass, a way around”
terms.comment: “So many feet round” is an ablative, circuitū, with the measure in the accusative.

phrases.latin: ejus crātēr patet circuitū quīngentōs pedēs

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 291.
Lewis & Short: pateo
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
